proof.text: Construct the signed tensor comparisons and normalized coefficient coordinates. Invert the projection square on the finite-Tor etale-origin pairs and compare the actual counit transpose with the finite theta word level by level. The coefficient-unit case is the adjunction triangle identity; tower-gamma finite equations provide the orientation and purity clauses.
